description: Route a data need through HSH (the data-fulfillment layer for agents). HSH checks its warm inventory first — if a matching product is pre-positioned, you get an immediate-fulfillment quote; otherwise a fresh-fulfillment quote. Use this when you need data mid-task and want HSH to fulfill it.

need.description: Plain-language description of the data you need
